source_name: UCLA Law Behind Bars Data Project, with Andrew Free
caveats: These counts are a minimum. They exclude deaths during arrest, before booking, in CBP custody (not consistently), and in jails holding someone on an ICE detainer.

ICE's own Detainee Death Reports exist from 2018 onward; earlier years rest mainly on FOIA records and may be incomplete. (All deaths in this layer are 2025 or later, so this mainly bears on how a given death was documented, not on which years are covered.)
This layer is scoped to the atlas's own study window (2025-01-20 onward); the facility-note counts shown elsewhere on the map cover the same window, not this dataset's full 2003-2026 history.
